title: Anne Frank House
visualBrief: Prinsengracht 263 only: three-bay black storefront and brick upper facade, white cornice and hoist, slate front-house roof, narrow connecting section and transverse red-tiled annex roof.

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Front threshold at signed local [2.69,17.25] on independently sampled host terrain; foundation extends to -1 m.

terrainReference.basis: Canal-side front threshold; original unmodified host terrain is sampled at this local coordinate.

geographicProposal.notes: The 5.88 by 24.1 m generalized envelope covers the front house and annex. Photo-derived partition: front z=3.3..16.7, connecting section z=-0.1..3.3, annex z=-7.4..-0.1. The rear roof ridge is transverse to the front-house ridge. These partitions are interpretive, not cadastral or measured. Modern museum and adjoining houses excluded.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior, not a measured reconstruction. Started with the cleared public-domain Qualla streetscape; independently verified CC0 archive exteriors and creator-released courtyard/door photos supply the missing views. Earlier CC photos, museum cutaway and model photograph are excluded from current imagery approval.
The zoom-15 map supplies a generalized 5.88 by 24.1 m envelope. Front/connector/annex partition and window/roof dimensions are estimates; small modern alterations and interiors are omitted.
Adjacent 261, 265 and the modern museum block are excluded. The former draft rear polygon was a neighboring property and has been removed.

Ground contact is reviewed against independently preserved coarse host-terrain samples; this is not elevation survey data. Photographs remain local comparison inputs and are not embedded. The archival rear, courtyard partitions, louver spacing, dormer depth and fine trim are generalized; small modern changes are omitted.
